plugin.name: Travel_Alias_Window
plugin.author: ChatGPT
plugin.purpose: Shows Travel alias-group speedwalks in a themed resizable responsive clickable miniwindow
plugin.description:
TRAVEL ALIAS WINDOW
Automatically lists WORLD aliases whose group is exactly:
travel
Each destination is clickable and executes the corresponding alias command.
Commands:
travelwin show travelwin hide travelwin refresh
Mouse wheel over the list to scroll.
Drag the lower-right corner to resize. The list automatically adds or removes columns with width and visible rows with height.
The window follows the shared themes:
theme default theme classic theme amber
Modular theme client: colours are supplied by UI_Theme_Controller v2.0 when available.

muclient.script:
require "movewindow"
Win = GetPluginID()
-------------------------------------------------- -- CONFIGURATION --------------------------------------------------
TRAVEL_GROUP = "travel"
DEFAULT_WINDOW_WIDTH = 195 DEFAULT_WINDOW_HEIGHT = 193 MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH = 130 MIN_WINDOW_HEIGHT = 118
TITLE_HEIGHT = 22 ROW_HEIGHT = 24
SCROLL_WIDTH = 15 SCROLL_BUTTON_HEIGHT = 15
-- Responsive grid: the historical 195 px window still resolves to two columns. -- Wider windows gain columns; narrower windows collapse to one. MIN_COLUMN_WIDTH = 76 MAX_COLUMNS = 8 COLUMN_GAP = 8
RESIZE_GRIP_SIZE = 12
WINDOW_WIDTH = math.max( MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH, tonumber(GetVariable("travel_window_width")) or DEFAULT_WINDOW_WIDTH )
WINDOW_HEIGHT = math.max( MIN_WINDOW_HEIGHT, tonumber(GetVariable("travel_window_height")) or DEFAULT_WINDOW_HEIGHT )
TELEPORT_HEIGHT = ROW_HEIGHT * 2
TEXT_INSET = 9
FONT_NAME = "Lucida Console" BODY_FONT_SIZE = 10 TITLE_FONT_SIZE = 9
-------------------------------------------------- -- SHARED UI THEMES --------------------------------------------------
THEME_CONTROLLER_ID = "43c8d047be7a418ba5e86916"
THEME_BROADCAST_MESSAGE = 9042
-------------------------------------------------- -- MODULAR THEME CLIENT -- -- The controller owns the real palette. The local THEMES table -- below is retained only as a safe fallback if the controller -- is unavailable. --------------------------------------------------
local THEME_PROFILE = "travel"
function ThemeColour( role, fallback )
local rc, value = CallPlugin( THEME_CONTROLLER_ID, "GetThemeColour", THEME_PROFILE, role )
if rc == error_code.eOK and type( value ) == "string" and value ~= "" then
return ColourNameToRGB( value )
end
return ColourNameToRGB( fallback ) end
THEMES = {
classic = { background = "#000000", border = "#808080", title_bar = "darkslategray", title = "gold",
text = "#D4D0C8", dim = "#707070",
row_hover = "#202020", separator = "#282828",
scroll_track = "#101010", scroll_thumb = "#606060", scroll_arrow = "#D4D0C8" },
amber = { background = "#050301", border = "#6B3D18", title_bar = "#160B03", title = "#FFB347",
text = "#E38B30", dim = "#6B3D18",
row_hover = "#241205", separator = "#2D1809",
scroll_track = "#0C0602", scroll_thumb = "#7A4318", scroll_arrow = "#FFB347" },
default = { background = "#000500", border = "#285B28", title_bar = "#061306", title = "#9AFF82",
text = "#70D970", dim = "#285328",
row_hover = "#0A1C0A", separator = "#102A10",
scroll_track = "#000A00", scroll_thumb = "#2E6B2E", scroll_arrow = "#9AFF82" } }
function LoadTheme()
local themeName = GetPluginVariable( THEME_CONTROLLER_ID, "theme" )
if not THEMES[themeName] then themeName = "default" end
local T = THEMES[themeName]
C_BACKGROUND = ThemeColour("background", T.background)
C_BORDER = ThemeColour("border", T.border)
C_TITLE_BAR = ThemeColour("title_bar", T.title_bar)
C_TITLE = ThemeColour("title", T.title)
C_TEXT = ThemeColour("text", T.text)
C_DIM = ThemeColour("dim", T.dim)
C_ROW_HOVER = ThemeColour("row_hover", T.row_hover)
C_SEPARATOR = ThemeColour("separator", T.separator)
C_SCROLL_TRACK = ThemeColour("scroll_track", T.scroll_track)
C_SCROLL_THUMB = ThemeColour("scroll_thumb", T.scroll_thumb)
C_SCROLL_ARROW = ThemeColour("scroll_arrow", T.scroll_arrow) end
LoadTheme()
-------------------------------------------------- -- STATE --------------------------------------------------
windowinfo = ""
travelAliases = {}
scrollOffset = 0
hoverIndex = nil
windowVisible = true
lastAliasSignature = ""
resizeActive = false
-- Track only the grid hotspots that existed on the previous frame. Seed with -- the legacy 2 x 30 geometry so reloading over v1.6 cleans up old hotspots once. lastGridRows = 30 lastGridColumns = 2
-------------------------------------------------- -- HELPERS --------------------------------------------------
function CurrentColumnCount()
local listRight = WINDOW_WIDTH - SCROLL_WIDTH
local usableWidth = math.max( 1, listRight - (TEXT_INSET * 2) )
local columns = math.floor( (usableWidth + COLUMN_GAP) / (MIN_COLUMN_WIDTH + COLUMN_GAP) )
columns = math.max( 1, math.min( MAX_COLUMNS, columns ) )
-- Do not manufacture empty columns when only a few destinations exist. if #travelAliases > 0 then columns = math.min( columns, #travelAliases ) end
return columns end
function VisibleRowCount()
return math.max( 1, math.floor( ( WINDOW_HEIGHT - TITLE_HEIGHT - TELEPORT_HEIGHT ) / ROW_HEIGHT ) ) end
function TotalLogicalRows()
local columnCount = CurrentColumnCount()
return math.ceil( #travelAliases / columnCount ) end
function MaxScrollOffset()
return math.max( 0, TotalLogicalRows() - VisibleRowCount() ) end
function ClampScroll()
scrollOffset = math.max( 0, math.min( scrollOffset, MaxScrollOffset() ) ) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- TURN A SIMPLE ALIAS MATCH INTO THE COMMAND -- -- Common Travel aliases are usually exact literal aliases, -- sometimes stored as regexp forms such as ^midgar$. --------------------------------------------------
function CommandFromMatch( matchText, isRegexp )
if not matchText then return nil end
local command = matchText
if isRegexp then
command = command:gsub( "^%^", "" )
command = command:gsub( "%$$", "" )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Unescape punctuation commonly escaped in exact -- regexp aliases. This is intentionally conservative. --------------------------------------------------
command = command:gsub( "\\([%-%._ ])", "%1" ) end
return command end
function DisplayNameFromCommand(command)
if not command or command == "" then
return "(unnamed)" end
return command end
-------------------------------------------------- -- READ TRAVEL ALIASES -- -- Sources: -- 1) ordinary world-level aliases in group "travel" -- 2) Automapper-owned persistent map bookmarks in group "travel" -- -- Both are invoked by Execute(command), so the UI behaves identically. --------------------------------------------------
AUTOMAPPER_PLUGIN_ID = "a7c3e91b4d6f2085c1e73a9d"
function AppendTravelAliases(found, seen, pluginId)
local aliasList = GetPluginAliasList(pluginId) if type(aliasList) ~= "table" then return end
for _, aliasName in pairs(aliasList) do local group = GetPluginAliasInfo(pluginId, aliasName, 16) if group == TRAVEL_GROUP then local matchText = GetPluginAliasInfo(pluginId, aliasName, 1) local enabled = GetPluginAliasInfo(pluginId, aliasName, 6) local isRegexp = GetPluginAliasInfo(pluginId, aliasName, 7) local command = CommandFromMatch(matchText, isRegexp == true)
if command and command ~= "" then local key = command:lower() if not seen[key] then seen[key] = true table.insert(found, { aliasName = aliasName, command = command, display = DisplayNameFromCommand(command), enabled = enabled ~= false, sourcePlugin = pluginId }) end end end end end
function LoadTravelAliases()
local found = {} local seen = {}
-- Preserve existing behaviour and precedence for manually-created aliases. AppendTravelAliases(found, seen, "") AppendTravelAliases(found, seen, AUTOMAPPER_PLUGIN_ID)
table.sort( found, function(a,b)
return a.display:lower() < b.display:lower() end )
travelAliases = found
ClampScroll() end
function AliasSignature()
local parts = {}
for _, item in ipairs( travelAliases ) do
table.insert( parts, item.aliasName .. "|" .. item.command .. "|" .. tostring(item.enabled) )
end
return table.concat( parts, "\n" ) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- HOTSPOTS --------------------------------------------------
function ClearDynamicHotspots()
-------------------------------------------------- -- Rows --------------------------------------------------
for row = 1, lastGridRows do
for column = 1, lastGridColumns do
WindowDeleteHotspot( Win, "travel_row_" .. tostring(row) .. "_" .. tostring(column) )
end
end
WindowDeleteHotspot( Win, "travel_scroll_up" )
WindowDeleteHotspot( Win, "travel_scroll_down" )
WindowDeleteHotspot( Win, "travel_scroll_area" )
WindowDeleteHotspot( Win, "travel_teleport" )
WindowDeleteHotspot( Win, "travel_resize" ) end
function IndexFromHotspot( hotspot_id )
local row, column = hotspot_id:match( "^travel_row_(%d+)_(%d+)$" )
row = tonumber(row)
column = tonumber(column)
if not row or not column then
return nil end
local columnCount = CurrentColumnCount()
if column > columnCount then return nil end
return ( scrollOffset * columnCount ) + ( (row - 1) * columnCount ) + column end
function ClickTravelRow( flags, hotspot_id )
local actualIndex = IndexFromHotspot( hotspot_id )
if not actualIndex then return end
local item = travelAliases[ actualIndex ]
if not item or not item.enabled then
return end
Execute( item.command ) end
function HoverTravelRow( flags, hotspot_id )
local actualIndex = IndexFromHotspot( hotspot_id )
if not actualIndex then return end
hoverIndex = actualIndex
DrawWindow() end
function LeaveTravelRow( flags, hotspot_id )
hoverIndex = nil
DrawWindow() end
function ClickTeleport( flags, hotspot_id )
Send("teleport") end
function ScrollUp( flags, hotspot_id )
scrollOffset = scrollOffset - 1
ClampScroll()
DrawWindow() end
function ScrollDown( flags, hotspot_id )
scrollOffset = scrollOffset + 1
ClampScroll()
DrawWindow() end
function ScrollWheel( flags, hotspot_id )
local amount = 3
if flags > 0 then
scrollOffset = scrollOffset + amount
else
scrollOffset = scrollOffset - amount
end
ClampScroll()
DrawWindow() end
-------------------------------------------------- -- RESIZE + RESPONSIVE GRID --------------------------------------------------
function SaveTravelWindowSize()
SetVariable( "travel_window_width", tostring(math.floor(WINDOW_WIDTH)) )
SetVariable( "travel_window_height", tostring(math.floor(WINDOW_HEIGHT)) ) end
function TravelResizeMouseDown( flags, hotspot_id )
resizeActive = true return 0 end
function UpdateTravelResizeFromMouse()
local mx = tonumber(WindowInfo(Win, 17))
local my = tonumber(WindowInfo(Win, 18))
local left = tonumber(WindowInfo(Win, 10)) or tonumber(WindowInfo(Win, 1)) or 0
local top = tonumber(WindowInfo(Win, 11)) or tonumber(WindowInfo(Win, 2)) or 0
if not mx or not my then return false end
local width = math.max( MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH, math.floor(mx - left + 1) )
local height = math.max( MIN_WINDOW_HEIGHT, math.floor(my - top + 1) )
if width == WINDOW_WIDTH and height == WINDOW_HEIGHT then return false end
WINDOW_WIDTH = width WINDOW_HEIGHT = height
WindowResize( Win, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, C_BACKGROUND )
Redraw() return true end
function TravelResizeMouseMove( flags, hotspot_id )
if resizeActive then UpdateTravelResizeFromMouse() end
SetCursor( miniwin.cursor_nw_se_arrow )
return 0 end
function TravelResizeMouseUp( flags, hotspot_id )
if resizeActive then UpdateTravelResizeFromMouse() end
resizeActive = false
ClampScroll() SaveTravelWindowSize() DrawWindow()
return 0 end
function InstallTravelResizeHandle()
WindowDeleteHotspot( Win, "travel_resize" )
WindowAddHotspot( Win, "travel_resize", WINDOW_WIDTH - RESIZE_GRIP_SIZE, WINDOW_HEIGHT - RESIZE_GRIP_SIZE, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, "", "", "TravelResizeMouseDown", "", "", "Drag to resize travel shortcuts", miniwin.cursor_nw_se_arrow, 0 )
WindowDragHandler( Win, "travel_resize", "TravelResizeMouseMove", "TravelResizeMouseUp", 0 )
WindowLine( Win, WINDOW_WIDTH - 11, WINDOW_HEIGHT - 3, WINDOW_WIDTH - 3, WINDOW_HEIGHT - 11, C_BORDER, miniwin.pen_solid, 1 )
WindowLine( Win, WINDOW_WIDTH - 7, WINDOW_HEIGHT - 3, WINDOW_WIDTH - 3, WINDOW_HEIGHT - 7, C_BORDER, miniwin.pen_solid, 1 ) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- SCROLLBAR --------------------------------------------------
function DrawArrow( cx, cy, direction )
local points
if direction == "up" then
points = string.format( "%d,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d", cx - 4, cy + 2, cx, cy - 3, cx + 4, cy + 2 )
else
points = string.format( "%d,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d", cx - 4, cy - 2, cx, cy + 3, cx + 4, cy - 2 )
end
WindowPolygon( Win, points, C_SCROLL_ARROW, miniwin.pen_solid, 1, C_SCROLL_ARROW, miniwin.brush_solid, true, false ) end
function DrawScrollbar()
local left = WINDOW_WIDTH - SCROLL_WIDTH
local trackTop = TITLE_HEIGHT + SCROLL_BUTTON_HEIGHT
local trackBottom = WINDOW_HEIGHT - RESIZE_GRIP_SIZE - SCROLL_BUTTON_HEIGHT
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_fill, left, TITLE_HEIGHT, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, C_SCROLL_TRACK )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Buttons --------------------------------------------------
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_frame, left, TITLE_HEIGHT, WINDOW_WIDTH, TITLE_HEIGHT + SCROLL_BUTTON_HEIGHT, C_BORDER )
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_frame, left, WINDOW_HEIGHT - RESIZE_GRIP_SIZE - SCROLL_BUTTON_HEIGHT, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT - RESIZE_GRIP_SIZE, C_BORDER )
DrawArrow( left + math.floor( SCROLL_WIDTH / 2 ), TITLE_HEIGHT + math.floor( SCROLL_BUTTON_HEIGHT / 2 ), "up" )
DrawArrow( left + math.floor( SCROLL_WIDTH / 2 ), WINDOW_HEIGHT - RESIZE_GRIP_SIZE - math.floor( SCROLL_BUTTON_HEIGHT / 2 ), "down" )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Thumb --------------------------------------------------
local trackHeight = trackBottom - trackTop
local visibleRows = VisibleRowCount()
local totalRows = math.max( TotalLogicalRows(), visibleRows )
local thumbHeight = math.max( 18, math.floor( trackHeight * visibleRows / totalRows ) )
local maxOffset = MaxScrollOffset()
local thumbTop = trackTop
if maxOffset > 0 then
thumbTop = trackTop + math.floor( ( trackHeight - thumbHeight ) * scrollOffset / maxOffset ) end
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_fill, left + 3, thumbTop, WINDOW_WIDTH - 3, thumbTop + thumbHeight, C_SCROLL_THUMB )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Scroll hotspots --------------------------------------------------
WindowAddHotspot( Win, "travel_scroll_up", left, TITLE_HEIGHT, WINDOW_WIDTH, TITLE_HEIGHT + SCROLL_BUTTON_HEIGHT, "", "", "", "", "ScrollUp", "Scroll up", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0 )
WindowAddHotspot( Win, "travel_scroll_down", left, WINDOW_HEIGHT - RESIZE_GRIP_SIZE - SCROLL_BUTTON_HEIGHT, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT - RESIZE_GRIP_SIZE, "", "", "", "", "ScrollDown", "Scroll down", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0 )
WindowAddHotspot( Win, "travel_scroll_area", left, trackTop, WINDOW_WIDTH, trackBottom, "", "", "", "", "", "Mouse wheel to scroll", miniwin.cursor_arrow, 0 )
WindowScrollwheelHandler( Win, "travel_scroll_area", "ScrollWheel" ) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- DRAW WINDOW --------------------------------------------------
function DrawWindow()
if not windowinfo then return end
ClearDynamicHotspots()
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_fill, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, C_BACKGROUND )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Title bar --------------------------------------------------
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_fill, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, TITLE_HEIGHT, C_TITLE_BAR )
WindowLine( Win, 0, TITLE_HEIGHT - 1, WINDOW_WIDTH, TITLE_HEIGHT - 1, C_BORDER, miniwin.pen_solid, 1 )
WindowText( Win, "title"..Win, "TRAVEL", TEXT_INSET, 4, WINDOW_WIDTH - SCROLL_WIDTH, TITLE_HEIGHT, C_TITLE, false )
-------------------------------------------------- -- TELEPORT BUTTON -- Full two-column width and two normal rows tall. --------------------------------------------------
local buttonLeft = TEXT_INSET
local buttonTop = TITLE_HEIGHT + 5
local buttonRight = WINDOW_WIDTH - SCROLL_WIDTH - TEXT_INSET
local buttonBottom = buttonTop + TELEPORT_HEIGHT - 6
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_fill, buttonLeft, buttonTop, buttonRight, buttonBottom, C_ROW_HOVER )
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_frame, buttonLeft, buttonTop, buttonRight, buttonBottom, C_BORDER )
local teleportTextWidth = WindowTextWidth( Win, "title"..Win, "Teleport" )
WindowText( Win, "title"..Win, "Teleport", math.floor( ( buttonLeft + buttonRight - teleportTextWidth ) / 2 ), buttonTop + math.floor( ( buttonBottom - buttonTop - ROW_HEIGHT ) / 2 ) + 4, buttonRight, buttonBottom, C_TITLE, false )
WindowAddHotspot( Win, "travel_teleport", buttonLeft, buttonTop, buttonRight, buttonBottom, "", "", "", "", "ClickTeleport", "Teleport", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0 )
WindowScrollwheelHandler( Win, "travel_teleport", "ScrollWheel" )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Rows: responsive columns --------------------------------------------------
local visibleRows = VisibleRowCount()
local columnCount = CurrentColumnCount()
local listRight = WINDOW_WIDTH - SCROLL_WIDTH
local usableWidth = listRight - (TEXT_INSET * 2)
local columnWidth = math.floor( ( usableWidth - ((columnCount - 1) * COLUMN_GAP) ) / columnCount )
for visibleRow = 1, visibleRows do
local top = TITLE_HEIGHT + TELEPORT_HEIGHT + ( (visibleRow - 1) * ROW_HEIGHT )
local bottom = top + ROW_HEIGHT
for column = 1, columnCount do
local actualIndex = ( scrollOffset * columnCount ) + ( (visibleRow - 1) * columnCount ) + column
local item = travelAliases[ actualIndex ]
if item then
local left = TEXT_INSET + ( (column - 1) * ( columnWidth + COLUMN_GAP ) )
local right = left + columnWidth
local textColour = item.enabled and C_TEXT or C_DIM
WindowText( Win, "body"..Win, item.display, left, top + 5, right - 2, bottom, textColour, false )
local hotspot_id = "travel_row_" .. tostring( visibleRow ) .. "_" .. tostring( column )
WindowAddHotspot( Win, hotspot_id, left - 3, top, right + 1, bottom, "", "", "", "", "ClickTravelRow", item.enabled and ("Travel: " .. item.command) or ("Disabled alias: " .. item.command), item.enabled and miniwin.cursor_hand or miniwin.cursor_arrow, 0 )
WindowScrollwheelHandler( Win, hotspot_id, "ScrollWheel" )
end
end
if visibleRow < visibleRows then
WindowLine( Win, TEXT_INSET, bottom - 1, listRight - 4, bottom - 1, C_SEPARATOR, miniwin.pen_solid, 1 )
end
end
lastGridRows = visibleRows lastGridColumns = columnCount
-------------------------------------------------- -- Column dividers --------------------------------------------------
for column = 1, columnCount - 1 do
local dividerX = TEXT_INSET + (column * columnWidth) + ((column - 1) * COLUMN_GAP) + math.floor( COLUMN_GAP / 2 )
WindowLine( Win, dividerX, TITLE_HEIGHT + TELEPORT_HEIGHT + 4, dividerX, WINDOW_HEIGHT - 4, C_SEPARATOR, miniwin.pen_solid, 1 )
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- Empty state --------------------------------------------------
if #travelAliases == 0 then
WindowText( Win, "body"..Win, "No aliases in group travel.", TEXT_INSET, TITLE_HEIGHT + TELEPORT_HEIGHT + 10, WINDOW_WIDTH - SCROLL_WIDTH - 5, 0, C_DIM, false )
end
DrawScrollbar()
-- Reinstall move/resize geometry after every responsive layout change. movewindow.add_drag_handler( Win, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, TITLE_HEIGHT )
InstallTravelResizeHandle()
-------------------------------------------------- -- Border --------------------------------------------------
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_frame, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, C_BORDER )
Redraw() end
-------------------------------------------------- -- REFRESH --------------------------------------------------
function RefreshAliases()
LoadTravelAliases()
lastAliasSignature = AliasSignature()
DrawWindow() end
function AutoRefreshAliases()
-- Never mutate hotspots while MUSHclient is dispatching the resize drag. if resizeActive then return end
local oldSignature = lastAliasSignature
LoadTravelAliases()
local newSignature = AliasSignature()
if newSignature ~= oldSignature then
lastAliasSignature = newSignature
DrawWindow() end end
-------------------------------------------------- -- INSTALL --------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginInstall()
LoadTheme()
check( WindowCreate( Win, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, 0, 0, C_BACKGROUND ) )
check( WindowFont( Win, "body"..Win, FONT_NAME, BODY_FONT_SIZE ) )
check( WindowFont( Win, "title"..Win, FONT_NAME, TITLE_FONT_SIZE, true ) )
windowinfo = movewindow.install( Win, miniwin.pos_top_right, miniwin.create_absolute_location, true )
check( WindowCreate( Win, windowinfo.window_left, windowinfo.window_top, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, windowinfo.window_mode, windowinfo.window_flags, C_BACKGROUND ) )
movewindow.add_drag_handler( Win, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, TITLE_HEIGHT )
RefreshAliases()
WindowShow( Win, true ) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- SAVE STATE --------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginSaveState()
SaveTravelWindowSize()
movewindow.save_state( Win )
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- ENABLE / DISABLE --------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginEnable()
LoadTheme()
RefreshAliases()
WindowShow( Win, true ) end
function OnPluginDisable()
WindowShow( Win, false ) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- COMMANDS --------------------------------------------------
function travelwin_show( name, line, wildcards )
windowVisible = true
RefreshAliases()
WindowShow( Win, true )
ColourNote( "yellow", "", "Travel window shown." ) end
function travelwin_hide( name, line, wildcards )
windowVisible = false
WindowShow( Win, false )
ColourNote( "yellow", "", "Travel window hidden." ) end
function travelwin_refresh( name, line, wildcards )
RefreshAliases()
ColourNote( "yellow", "", "Travel aliases refreshed (" .. tostring( #travelAliases ) .. " found)." ) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- THEME BROADCAST --------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginBroadcast( msg, id, name, text )
if msg ~= THEME_BROADCAST_MESSAGE then return end
if id ~= THEME_CONTROLLER_ID then return end
LoadTheme()
DrawWindow() end
-------------------------------------------------- -- PLUGIN CONTROLLER LAYOUT API --------------------------------------------------
function ManagedLayoutParse(spec) local windowName, sx, sy, sw, sh = tostring(spec or ""):match("^([^\t]+)\t(-?%d+)\t(-?%d+)\t(%d+)\t(%d+)$") if not windowName then return nil end return windowName, tonumber(sx), tonumber(sy), tonumber(sw), tonumber(sh) end
function ManagedLayoutSetMoveWindowInfo(info, winName, x, y) if type(info) ~= "table" then return end info.window_left = x info.window_top = y info.window_mode = tonumber(WindowInfo(winName, 7)) or info.window_mode or miniwin.pos_top_left info.window_flags = tonumber(WindowInfo(winName, 8)) or info.window_flags or miniwin.create_absolute_location end
function GetManagedLayoutWindows() return Win end
function ApplyManagedLayout(spec) local windowName, x, y, w, h = ManagedLayoutParse(spec) if windowName ~= Win then return "wrong window" end
WINDOW_WIDTH = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH, math.floor(w)) WINDOW_HEIGHT = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_HEIGHT, math.floor(h)) SaveTravelWindowSize() ClampScroll()
WindowResize( Win, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, C_BACKGROUND )
ManagedLayoutSetMoveWindowInfo(windowinfo, Win, x, y) DrawWindow()
local mode = type(windowinfo) == "table" and windowinfo.window_mode or miniwin.pos_top_left local flags = type(windowinfo) == "table" and windowinfo.window_flags or miniwin.create_absolute_location WindowPosition(Win, x, y, mode, flags) if movewindow then movewindow.save_state(Win) end pcall(SaveState) Redraw() return "ok" end
